statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration. Earlier versions created (RailwayServiceInstance)-[:EXPOSE]->(RailwayServiceDomain); the schema now creates the edge the other way round, so that EXPOSE always runs from the internet-facing entrypoint to the asset it puts at risk. Only the legacy orientation is deleted: the correct one is recreated by the loader on every sync, so there is nothing to backfill, and copying lastupdated onto a fabricated edge would only invent a stale one. Generated cleanup matches the new orientation only, which is why these would otherwise linger forever and leave the graph holding both directions. Remove in v1.0.0.
statements.query: MATCH (:RailwayServiceInstance)-[r:EXPOSE]->(:RailwayServiceDomain) WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS TotalCompleted
